In detail

No specific, current (2022-2025) safety-relevant press coverage was found for Campamento beyond general district statistics. Older reports (2013, 2019) of assaults/robberies exist but fall well outside the recent-coverage window and were not corroborated by any more recent source. Current news instead concerns the large urban-regeneration project on former military land. Sources checked: Search for 2022-2025 coverage: no substantive results found; Ayuntamiento de Madrid, 2023-2025 (Operacion Campamento, non-crime).

Frequently asked questions

Is Campamento safe?

Wandroz currently rates Campamento in Madrid as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Campamento safe at night?

At night, Campamento is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Campamento a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Campamento's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
